Read cost adjustment provenance

Source: R/cost.R
nis_cost_provenance.Rd

Returns the metadata recorded by nis_cost() or nis_design() when cost adjustment was requested. Data frame operations may drop custom attributes; call this on the direct nis_cost() result or on the survey design returned by nis_design().

Usage

nis_cost_provenance(.data)

Arguments

.data

A data frame returned by nis_cost() or a survey design returned by nis_design().

Value

A list describing the charge and CCR fields, CPI-U source and base year, annual multipliers, counts of invalid CCR and of missing or invalid charges, and output meanings. Returns NULL when no cost adjustment provenance is present.

See also

Derive outcomes, comorbidities, and costs, Derive outcomes, comorbidities, and costs.

Other costs: nis_cost()

Examples

charges <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019)) |>
  dplyr::select(YEAR, TOTCHG, CCR_NIS) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  nis_cost(dollars = 2024)
